search: WITH _opts AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST("domain_id" AS VARCHAR) AS val FROM concepts WHERE "domain_id" IS NOT NULL) SELECT val, COUNT(*) OVER ()::INTEGER AS total FROM _opts WHERE ((contains(strip_accents(LOWER(val)), strip_accents(LOWER('myco')))) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _opts _lf WHERE contains(strip_accents(LOWER(_lf.val)), strip_accents(LOWER('myco')))) AND jaro_winkler_similarity(strip_accents(LOWER(val)), strip_accents(LOWER('myco'))) >= 0.85)) ORDER BY val LIMIT 1000
